mapper.select: select cast(id as varchar) as id, cast(user_id as varchar) as user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at from refresh_tokens where token_hash = #{tokenHash}

select cast(id as varchar) as id, cast(user_id as varchar) as user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at from refresh_tokens where user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) order by issued_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into refresh_tokens (id, user_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, revoked, revoked_at) values ( cast(#{id} as uuid), cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revoked}, #{revokedAt} )
mapper.update: update refresh_tokens set revoked = true, revoked_at = #{revokedAt}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = cast(#{id} as uuid) and revoked = false
